capabilities: Create multiple tag-rooted tree views in the sidebar or main area
Drag notes between branches to rewrite their frontmatter tags
Rename a branch to retag every note under it
Browse all vault tags in a read-only tag browser
disambiguation: Despite the name, it builds trees from frontmatter tags, not the vault's actual folder structure, which is never altered.
extras: Can be installed via BRAT before community plugin approval; themes style the panes automatically because they mirror the File Explorer and Tags markup.
intentEvidence: a drop-in alternative to core's Tags pane
problem: Obsidian's Tags view only runs searches and the file explorer mirrors real folders, so tags cannot be browsed or rearranged as an editable hierarchy.

relations.evidence: a read-only tree of every tag in the vault (a drop-in alternative to core's Tags pane)

summary: Adds tag-rooted file tree views where dragging notes between branches rewrites their frontmatter tags, plus a read-only tag browser pane.
